subject: Using as.formula() with the reshape package cast

messages.author: d0ba05bcd06163ff
messages.subject: Using as.formula() with the reshape package cast
parts:
I am trying to use the "cast" function from the reshape package, where the formula is not passed in directly, but as the result of the as.formula() function.

Using reshape v. 0.7.2

I am able to properly melt() by data with:

> molten <- melt(x, id=1:2)

then I can properly cast with this:

> cast(molten, days ~ variable)

but if I try

> cast(molten, as.function("days ~ variable"))

if returns the error:

Error in check_formula(formula, varnames) :
        Formula contains variables not in list of known variables

I am not sure if the problem is with cast or as.formula()

I did confirm that:

> x <- days ~ variable

> y <- as.formula("days ~ variable")

> x==y
TRUE
